title: Weekly Alcohol Units vs Guideline
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=alcohol:drink
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(units) as units by _time
| eval guideline=14, over=if(units>guideline,1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Adds up your weekly alcohol units and compares them to the recommended guideline so a slow creep is visible.
value: Counting units against a clear guideline is far more honest than a vague sense of how much you drink.
implementation: Log drinks with units into `index=personal`; alert when the weekly total exceeds the guideline.
visualization: Column chart of weekly alcohol units with a guideline line.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up how much alcohol you drink each week against the recommended limit, keeping it honest.
